visualCharacteristics: 14 image-only linked slides. Full-viewport slides, each a single artwork image (location title and 'Know more' baked in) centred over a map-pattern block background; whole slide clickable; large circular prev/next arrows at mid-height; short dash indicators bottom-centre.
contentPattern: Per slide (row): cell 1 image + alt ('<City> Experience Centre', desktop 1920x1080 rendition); cell 2 link to /dealer/<slug> + link text (screen-reader label, e.g. 'New Delhi Experience Centre - Know more'). Map-pattern background (dealer-carousel-bg) is block-level CSS.
